title: My Tutorial
text:
The code
"""Example script students run: python code/analysis.py"""
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
x = np.arange(2000, 2024)
y = 0.3 + 0.002 * (x - 2000) + rng.normal(0, 0.02, x.size)

out = Path(__file__).parent / "output"
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ax.plot(x, y, marker="o")
ax.set(xlabel="Year", ylabel="Value", title="Example time series")
fig.savefig(out / "example.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
print(f"Saved {out / 'example.png'}")
